facts.text: Chamberlain University's College of Nursing offers an accelerated 3-year Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree for students entering without a prior nursing degree or RN license.

sources.title: BSN and RN to BSN Bachelor's Programs | Chamberlain University
sources.quote: For prospective students without a nursing degree or registered nursing license, Chamberlain University's College of Nursing offers the 3-year Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree.
